sources.title: 索尼与华纳起诉Anthropic，指控其大规模盗用版权音乐训练Claude / Sony and Warner sue Anthropic over "one of the largest and most blatant ongoing thefts of intellectual property in history"

sources.title_original: Sony and Warner sue Anthropic over "one of the largest and most blatant ongoing thefts of intellectual property in history"
sources.summary: 索尼音乐、华纳音乐等唱片公司起诉Anthropic及其CEO Dario Amodei和联合创始人Benjamin Mann，指控其未经许可使用数万首受版权保护的音乐作品（主要是歌词）训练Claude模型。原告称Amodei明确指示并促成侵权行为，每件侵权作品索赔最高15万美元。此前Anthropic已于2025年9月就盗版书籍训练达成15亿美元和解。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Sony Music与Warner Music起诉Anthropic及CEO Dario Amodei，指控其用数万首版权音乐训练Claude，索赔每件高达15万美元；此前Anthropic刚为盗版图书支付15亿美元和解。

sources.summary:
I still get to control whether other people can see the session, but I don’t lose it. I don’t get the “unprofessional” argument. This is attribution. Attribution is professional. If you don’t want it, you turn it off or rewrite the commit messages. If you are having Claude write the commit messages FOR YOU and you are NOT READING THEM then that’s what’s unprofessional. I am honestly kind of shocked and disappointed by how upset people are by this.
I don’t get the “unprofessional” argument. This
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 默认在commit和PR里附上Claude会话链接，需账户及权限才能查看，被批为Git日志中的广告，让人联想到Microsoft Copilot此前的做法。

sources.summary: > Sadnan Khan was ordered to pay $1,230 towards the supermarket giant's legal fees after a landmark Fair Work Commission decision found he used AI as a "quasi-legal advisor" to challenge his dismissal, despite repeat warnings his case had "no substantial prospects of success". > "I have taken the very rare step of ordering him to pay some of the employer's legal costs, because his unreasonable conduct caused his former employer to incur those costs unnecessarily," Fair Work Commission deputy pre

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Fair Work Commission裁定Sadnan Khan用AI作“准法律顾问”挑战解雇属“plain wrong”，须支付$1,230法律费用；但文中也提到Macquarie University讲师用AI维权成功的案例，提醒AI法律建议需甄别。

items.persona_review: 监管层提醒AI法律建议不可靠，做法律相关产品的得自查合规，无直接影响。

items.title: Debian 投票通过允许负责任地使用生成式 AI / Debian votes to allow "responsible use of generative AI"

sources.title: Debian 投票通过允许负责任地使用生成式 AI / Debian votes to allow "responsible use of generative AI"
sources.title_zh: Debian 投票通过允许负责任地使用生成式 AI
sources.title_en: Debian votes to allow "responsible use of generative AI"
sources.title_original: Debian votes to allow "responsible use of generative AI"
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Debian投票通过决议，允许在负责任前提下使用生成式AI：贡献者须理解并维护AI辅助代码，AI不得独立提交，须注明模型；审阅者抱怨每月收到数百个补丁。

sources.title: Debian 投票通过允许“负责任地使用生成式人工智能”
sources.title_zh: Debian 投票通过允许“负责任地使用生成式人工智能”
sources.title_original: Debian 投票通过允许“负责任地使用生成式人工智能”
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Debian通过决议，既不禁止也不支持生成式AI，但要求贡献者须为AI输出负责；两个极端反AI提案（改社会契约与行为准则）均未击败‘以上皆非’，约30%选民仍支持禁用，最终维持现状。
